units.source_text: 且说母尼僧有一个孙子，是在纪伊国当国守的，此次从任地回到京都。

en.t: Now the mother nun had a grandson who served as governor of Kii Province, and this time he had returned to the capital from his post.

units.source_text: 其人年约三十岁左右，相貌端整，意气轩昂。

en.t: He was about thirty years old, handsome in appearance, and carried himself with a proud and spirited air.

units.source_text: 他向祖母问候：“孙儿离京已有两年，这期间祖母安好么？”

en.t: He greeted his grandmother and said, "Your grandson has been away from the capital for two years. Have you been well during that time?"

units.source_text: 老祖母年已老耄，回答不清。

en.t: The old grandmother had grown senile with age and could not answer clearly.

units.source_text: 他就去访问姑母，即妹尼僧，对她说道：“老祖母竟全然昏聩了，真可怜啊！

en.t: He then went to visit his aunt, the younger nun, and said to her, "Grandmother has become completely confused. How pitiful!

units.source_text: 看来余命无多了。

en.t: It seems she does not have much life left.

units.source_text: 我不能侍奉在侧而长年远游他乡，实甚不该！

en.t: It was truly wrong of me to spend so many years away in distant places instead of staying by her side to serve her.

units.source_text: 我自父母双亡之后，一直把这老祖母当作父母看待呢。

en.t: Ever since both my parents died, I have always regarded this grandmother as my parent.

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人常来访问么？”

en.t: Does the wife of the Governor of Hitachi often come to visit?"

units.source_text: 所谓常陆守夫人，大概是这纪伊守的妹妹吧。

en.t: The wife of the Governor of Hitachi was probably this Governor of Kii's younger sister.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧答道：“这里一年一年地过去，总是冷冷清清，越来越寂寥。

en.t: The younger nun replied, "The years pass here one after another, always cold and lonely, and it grows more desolate all the time.

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人久无音信了。

en.t: There has been no word from the wife of the Governor of Hitachi for a long time.

units.source_text: 生怕你祖母等不到她回来呢。”

en.t: I fear that your grandmother may not live long enough to see her return."

units.source_text: 浮舟听见他说起“常陆守夫人”，以为是她的母亲，不知不觉地倾耳而听。

en.t: When Ukifune heard him mention "the wife of the Governor of Hitachi," she thought it must mean her mother and unconsciously listened more closely.

units.source_text: 纪伊守又说：“我返京已有好多天了。

en.t: The Governor of Kii went on, "It has already been many days since I returned to the capital.

units.source_text: 只因公事繁忙，一直不得脱身。

en.t: But official business has kept me so busy that I have not been able to get away.

units.source_text: 昨天本想到这里来的，又因薰大将赴宇治，我须奉陪，以致未果。

en.t: Yesterday I meant to come here, but General Kaoru went to Uji and I had to accompany him, so I could not manage it.

units.source_text: 他在已故八亲王的山庄里耽搁了一天。

en.t: He spent the whole day at the late Eighth Prince's mountain villa.

units.source_text: 这是因为：薰大将和八亲王家大女公子通好，大女公子于前年亡故了。

en.t: This was because General Kaoru had been intimate with the elder daughter of the Eighth Prince's household, and that elder daughter had died the year before last.

units.source_text: 后来他又爱上了她的妹妹，悄悄地将她安顿在这山庄里，岂知这妹妹又在去年春天亡故了。

en.t: Later he fell in love with her younger sister as well and secretly settled her in that mountain villa, but unexpectedly that younger sister also died last spring.

units.source_text: 这回他是为了替她办周年忌辰的佛事，去找那山寺里的律师，吩咐应有事宜。

en.t: This time he went to find the vinaya master at the mountain temple to arrange the necessary matters for the Buddhist rites on the anniversary of her death.

units.source_text: 我也想奉赠一套女子服装，作为布施品。

en.t: I would also like to offer a set of women's clothing as an alms gift.

units.source_text: 可否在你这里缝制？

en.t: Could it be sewn here with you?

units.source_text: 衣料可叫他们赶紧织起来。”

en.t: I can have the fabric woven quickly."

units.source_text: 浮舟听了这话，安得不感慨呢！

en.t: How could Ukifune hear these words without being deeply moved?

units.source_text: 她怕别人看见，背转身子，朝里面坐了。

en.t: Afraid that others would see her, she turned her back and sat facing inward.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧问道：“听说这位得道的八亲王有两位女公子，匂亲王夫人不知道是哪一位？”

en.t: The younger nun asked, "I have heard that this enlightened Eighth Prince had two daughters. Which one, I wonder, became Prince Niou's wife?"

units.source_text: 但纪伊守只管继续说：“薰大将后来爱上的那一位，是身份低微的人所生的。

en.t: But the Governor of Kii simply continued, "The one General Kaoru later loved was born to a woman of low status.

units.source_text: 大将没有十分重视她，如今后悔莫及，非常悲伤。

en.t: The General did not value her highly enough, and now he is too late to regret it and is terribly grief stricken.

units.source_text: 起初那一位死的时候，他也非常悲伤，几乎为此出家呢。”

en.t: When the first lady died, he was also deeply sorrowful, almost to the point of taking religious vows because of it."

units.source_text: 浮舟推想这纪伊守是薰大将所亲信的人，不觉害怕起来。

en.t: Ukifune guessed that this Governor of Kii was someone trusted by General Kaoru, and before she knew it she became afraid.

units.source_text: 但闻纪伊守继续说道：“奇怪得很，两位女公子都是在宇治亡故的。

en.t: But she heard the Governor of Kii continue, "It is very strange: both young ladies died in Uji.

units.source_text: 我看大将昨天的神色，还是非常悲戚呢。

en.t: When I saw the General's expression yesterday, he still looked terribly grief stricken.

units.source_text: 他走到宇治川岸边，向水上望望，十分伤心地哭泣。

en.t: He walked to the bank of the Uji River, gazed out over the water, and wept in great sorrow.

units.source_text: 后来回到室中，在柱子上题一首诗：

en.t: Afterward he returned to the room and wrote a poem on a pillar:
